court: Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit

issues.label: Standing to seek judicial review
issues.why: Court must confirm Friends of Animals has Article III and statutory standing to challenge the Plan and permits.

issues.label: Ripeness of challenge to Plan
issues.why: Whether challenge to the ten-year Plan and future certificates of inclusion is ripe for review.

issues.label: Standard of review under APA
issues.why: Agency action is reviewed under arbitrary-and-capricious standard, framing all substantive analysis.

issues.label: Deference to Service's interpretations
issues.why: Whether and how much deference applies to the Service's reading of the ESA and its scientific findings.

issues.label: Authority to issue master permits
issues.why: Whether the ESA authorizes county-held master permits and county-issued certificates of inclusion to developers.

issues.label: 'Otherwise lawful activity' incidental-take requirement
issues.why: Section 1539(a)(1)(B) permits only takes incidental to otherwise lawful conduct.

issues.label: Maximum-extent-practicable minimization finding
issues.why: Whether the Service properly found impacts minimized and mitigated to the maximum extent practicable.

issues.label: Assurance of adequate funding
issues.why: Whether reliance on Utah funds and developer fees satisfies the funding-assurance requirement.

issues.label: Survival-and-recovery / no-appreciable-reduction finding
issues.why: Whether takes would appreciably reduce likelihood of survival and recovery of the species.

issues.label: Jeopardy determination adequacy
issues.why: Whether the no-jeopardy finding is supported and consistent with recovery-unit importance.

issues.label: Reliance on historical-average projections
issues.why: Whether using historic averages to project habitat loss was reasonable given acknowledged possibility of higher development.

issues.label: Adequacy of the fivefold-increase analysis
issues.why: Whether the sensitivity analysis reasonably accounted for greater-than-projected habitat destruction.

issues.label: Efficacy of translocation mitigation
issues.why: Whether reliance on translocation to offset takes is supported by evidence of success.

issues.label: 'Fully offset' mitigation conclusion
issues.why: Whether the finding that mitigation fully offsets 7,152 takes is rational and supported.

issues.label: Recovery-unit essential-habitat treatment
issues.why: Whether authorizing takes in areas essential to recovery is consistent with the ESA.

issues.label: Adequacy of adaptive-management/monitoring provisions
issues.why: Whether annual review and monitoring adequately allow correction if mitigation fails.

issues.label: NEPA: EA versus EIS requirement
issues.why: Whether a finding of no significant impact was proper or an EIS was required.

issues.label: NEPA significance and cumulative impacts
issues.why: Whether the Service adequately assessed significance, cumulative effects, and reasonable alternatives.

issues.label: Consistency with threatened-species 4(d) rule
issues.why: Whether the take prohibition and permit scheme conform to the Service's 4(d) regulation for threatened species.

issues.label: Consideration of species' full range
issues.why: Whether the analysis addressed a significant portion of the species' range as the statute requires.

issues.label: Remedy if violations found
issues.why: Court must determine appropriate relief, such as vacatur or remand of the Plan and permits.
